about.title: Bringing technology and business together
paragraphs: My name is Jakub. I’m an IT specialist and software developer with many years of experience in the FMCG, pharmaceutical, fuel and legal sectors. I’ve worked in teams of all sizes, using dozens of different tools and processes. That experience has taught me how much it matters to fit technology to a business’s real needs.

I started Latarnik to bring best practices and technology once available only to large organisations to small businesses. I help business owners improve processes and introduce tools that let them work faster and more efficiently.
